subject: StarterKit trial credit qualification — Cardinal AI
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@cardinalai.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: StarterKit trial credits — qualification & next steps

Hi Dev,

Thanks again for the demo on Friday — the latency profiles and the dedicated cache features look like a strong fit for how we prototype embeddings-heavy features. We’re an early-stage team (Cardinal AI) building a document understanding layer and want to pilot Redwood on a 6-week sprint.

Quick context: we have a 3-person engineering team, ~20k tokens/day in dev tests today, and expect a burst to ~200k tokens/day during the sprint. Our ask: 3 months of trial credits or an interim top-up to cover the sprint burst so we can validate production perf before committing to Dedicated.

Attached is a short MVP usage plan and a traffic forecast. Can you confirm what your trial credit qualification looks like (milestones, usage caps, any compliance checks)? If you need a simple purchase/order form signed, happy to get that over.

Would like to get something in place before next Monday (Aug 2) if possible — happy to jump on a 30m call.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Founder, Cardinal AI
samantha@cardinalai.com
(415) 555-0123

[attachment: MVP-usage-plan.pdf (PDF, 68KB)]
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@cardinalai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StarterKit trial credits — qualification & next steps

Hi Samantha — great to meet during the demo and thanks for the plan. Looping in Laura (Growth) to align on credits and Marcus (Revenue Ops) for order paperwork.

Short answers up front:
- We can provision a conditional trial credit allocation to cover the 6-week sprint bursts you described. Typical approach is a staged allocation tied to milestone checks (usage pattern, no large-scale scraping, and agreement to basic monitoring hooks).
- For a top-up we usually issue a time-limited promo credit pool (applies to hosted API only) while we complete quick procurement paperwork.

Can you confirm: expected max concurrency, whether PII will be sent (and if so whether you require VPC/private deployment), and any required billing/PO process? If you can fill out the two bullets below we can fast-track approval: 
  1) Expected peak tokens/day and token split by embed vs. generation
  2) Primary contact for billing/purchase order

Proposed next step: 30m call tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize the numbers and get Marcus the signed order form if needed. If that works, Laura will kick off a temporary promo and Marcus will prepare an order form draft.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@cardinalai.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StarterKit trial credits — qualification & next steps

On Mon, Aug 02, 2027 at 09:04 AM Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Can you confirm: expected max concurrency, whether PII will be sent ...

Thanks Dev — answers inline:
- Peak tokens/day: ~220k (embedding ~160k, generation ~60k)
- Concurrency: typically 8-12 concurrent requests during load tests
- PII: only hashed identifiers in prompt, no raw PII. We are fine with hosted API for the trial.
- Billing contact: Tom Price (tom@cardinalai.com) — Tom handles vendor contracts.

Attaching MVP plan again. We prefer a single promo pool that covers the sprint (Aug 3 1 Sep 13) and would like a confirmation e-mail that credits will be applied prior to our load tests on Aug 4. If a quick order form helps, I attached the company details.

Two other notes: if you offer a short-term usage cap to prevent unexpected billing overages that would help our finance team feel comfortable. Also curious if Redwood can provide a simple performance SLA for the trial window (p95 latency target) so we can evaluate against our benchmarks.

Best,
Samantha

[attachment: MVP-usage-plan.pdf (PDF, 68KB)]
[attachment: order-form-draft.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@cardinalai.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 18:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: StarterKit trial credits — qualification & next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick summary and decision:

1) Conditional promo credit: we can provision a one-time trial pool of $7,500 in promo credits applied to your Cardinal AI account, valid for the sprint window (2027-08-03 to 2027-09-13). Credits will be visible in the dashboard and applied to hosted API usage.

2) Conditions:
  - Usage must follow the forecast you provided (peak ~220k tokens/day). If we see sustained usage >2x forecast we may pause the promo and reach out.
  - No transfer of raw PII; hashed identifiers are fine.
  - We require simple telemetry: one sample trace per day and a short post-sprint evaluation call to review cost/latency and next steps.

3) SLA: for the trial window we commit to best-effort routing with target p95 request latency < 450ms on our hosted small model variants; please note that bursts and sequence-length variance can affect observed latency.

4) Paperwork: Marcus will send a short order form to Tom for signatures. Marcus — please attach the DocuSign order and the promo activation checklist.

Samantha — if you confirm acceptance of the above conditions we will activate the $7.5k promo by EOD tomorrow and schedule a 30m check-in on Aug 6 to review telemetry.

Thanks and excited to support the pilot,
Laura Bennett
Director, Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
laura@redwoodinference.com
